name: Pittsboro (United States)
description: White field within a black border, charged with a large red letter P bearing a white star, the name Pittsboro and est. 1834 in white on a navy blue stripe along the bottom.
history: Pittsboro is a town in Middle and Brown townships, Hendricks County, Indiana. The flag was adopted in 2018 (chosen by the town council on 19 June 2018 from ten entries in a flag contest, according to Flags of the World quoting the council minutes).
